````text
# #3224: Patch: hold the menu stylesheets to the radius, shadow, layer and motion tokens
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What it does

The design tokens (#2105 palette, #2107 type scale, #2109 surfaces, #2110 motion) are enforced on the board, but only partly on the menus:

- `src/palette.test.ts` (`UNMIGRATED`) and `src/typescale.test.ts` (`UNSCALED`) count raw colors and sizes in every other stylesheet, so a menu sheet cannot add more.
- `src/surfaces.test.ts:215` and `src/motion.test.ts:171` check only `BOARD_SHEETS`. A menu stylesheet can add any raw `border-radius`, `box-shadow`, `z-index`, duration or curve, and nothing fails.

Approximate raw counts today:

| Sheet | Radii | z-index | Motion |
|---|---|---|---|
| lobby | 23 | 0 | 5 |
| practice | 23 | 10 | 16 |
| tutorial | 22 | 6 | 3 |
| deckbuilder | 18 | 10 | 4 |
| patches | 18 | 1 | 0 |
| tavern | 14 | 2 | 3 |
| stats | 13 | 1 | 3 |
| settings | 13 | 1 | 3 |

The dungeon sheets are the only menu sheets on the tokens throughout.

Change: extend `surfaces.test.ts` and `motion.test.ts` to every stylesheet under `apps/web/src`, the way `palette.test.ts` does. The board sheets stay at zero, and every other sheet is held to its current count in a per-sheet allowlist (`UNTOKENED_SURFACES`, `UNTOKENED_MOTION`, or similar), equal to what it has today. A sheet's count can only go down, by moving its values onto the tokens. Card art and other sheets with a real reason may stay listed with that reason, as `KEEP` does today.

No visual change. Do not migrate the sheets in this issue beyond trivial exact matches (`999px` to `--radius-pill`, `50%` to `--radius-round`); the other issues in this design pass reduce the counts as they touch each sheet.

### Acceptance

- `surfaces.test.ts` and `motion.test.ts` cover every `.css` file under `apps/web/src`, not only `BOARD_SHEETS`.
- Each non-board sheet with raw values is listed with its count, and the test fails if a count rises or a new sheet adds raw values.
- The README's surfaces and motion paragraphs say the menus are now counted.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test` passes.

### Blocked by, part of

None.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-3` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42087457708)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

`surfaces.test.ts` and `motion.test.ts` will count raw values in every `.css` file under `apps/web/src`, as `palette.test.ts` does. The board sheets stay at zero. Every other sheet is held to its current count in a per-sheet allowlist, `UNTOKENED_SURFACES` and `UNTOKENED_MOTION`. A count may only go down, and a new sheet cannot add raw values. The README's surfaces and motion paragraphs say the menus are counted. No CSS changes, so there is no visual change.

## Files to touch

| Path | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/surfaces.test.ts` | change | Header comment; `UNTOKENED_SURFACES`; one new `it` in `describe("#2109 no one-off surfaces")` |
| `apps/web/src/motion.test.ts` | change | Header comment; `UNTOKENED_MOTION`; one new `describe` with one `it` |
| `apps/web/README.md` | change | The surfaces paragraph (line 52) and the motion paragraph (line 54) |

Do not touch: any `.css` file, any `.tsx` component, `palette.test.ts`, `typescale.test.ts`, `crates/`, `spec/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. No ruling is made, so there is no `spec/rulings/` note, no `spec/pending/` file and no patch fragment. A web-only test change has none (compare #3200). The governing text is the #2109 and #2110 paragraphs of `apps/web/README.md`.

## Steps

Before step 1, run `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` once from the repo root. A single-file `vitest run` fails with "Failed to resolve import ./pkg/jackioh_wasm.js" until the wasm module exists. `pnpm --dir apps/web test <file>` runs it first as `pretest`.

1. `apps/web/src/surfaces.test.ts`, header comment (lines 1-4): add one sentence saying every other stylesheet, the menus' included, is held to its count in `UNTOKENED_SURFACES`. Cite only `#2109` and `#3224`. Do not write an `R<n>` id in any new comment or test title, because `cargo jackioh spec check` scans `apps/web/src/` for them.

2. Same file, after `BOARD_SHEETS` (line 34), add the allowlist. Copy the shape of `UNMIGRATED` in `palette.test.ts`: one entry per line, keys sorted.
   ```ts
   /** Every other sheet's own radii, shadows, layers and gradients, counted as the board's test finds them (card faces, the table and fx keep their gradients by design): one that moves values onto surfaces.css lowers its number, and none gains one. */
   const UNTOKENED_SURFACES: Record<string, number> = { …the 60 entries below… };
   ```

3. Same file, in `describe("#2109 no one-off surfaces")`, after the board's `it` (after line 219), add:
   ```ts
   it("#2109 no other stylesheet gains a radius, a shadow, a layer or a gradient of its own", () => {
     const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
     for (const sheet of SHEETS) {
       if (BOARD_SHEETS.includes(sheet)) continue;
       const css = codeOf(sheet);
       const own = offSurface(css).length + offShadow(css).length;
       if (own > 0) counts[sheet] = own;
     }
     expect(counts, "name a radius, a shadow and a layer (surfaces.css) instead; a sheet that loses some lowers its number in UNTOKENED_SURFACES").toEqual(UNTOKENED_SURFACES);
   });
   ```
   Do not wrap the non-board css in `withoutTable`: it changes no count today, and `game/table.css` is a non-board sheet. Do not change the board test or any helper.

4. `apps/web/src/motion.test.ts`, header comment (line 1): add that every other sheet's raw durations and curves are counted in `UNTOKENED_MOTION`.

5. Same file, after `ANIM_SCALED` (line 64), add `UNTOKENED_MOTION: Record<string, number>` with the 36 entries below. Give it a `/** … */` comment. The count is each non-board sheet's own durations (`ownTimes`) plus its transitions and animations that name no curve (`offCurve`). Loops, art and the table's marks are among them. One that moves onto motion.css lowers its number, and none gains one. Leave `KEEP` alone: it stays the board's.

6. Same file, at the end (after line 191), add:
   ```ts
   describe("#2110 the menus' motion is counted", () => {
     it("#2110 no other stylesheet gains a duration or a curve of its own", () => {
       const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
       for (const sheet of SHEETS) {
         if (BOARD_SHEETS.includes(sheet)) continue;
         const css = codeOf(sheet);
         const own = offCurve(css).length + ownTimes(sheet, css).length;
         if (own > 0) counts[sheet] = own;
       }
       expect(counts, "name a duration and a curve (motion.css) instead; a sheet that loses some lowers its number in UNTOKENED_MOTION").toEqual(UNTOKENED_MOTION);
     });
   });
   ```

7. `apps/web/README.md`, line 52 (surfaces): after "...gradient inline." append: "Every other stylesheet, the menus' among them, is held to its count of raw radii, shadows, layers and gradients in `UNTOKENED_SURFACES`: a sheet that moves values onto the tokens lowers its number, and none gains one (the dungeon's sheets state none)."
   Line 54 (motion): after "...in `KEEP`." append: "Every other stylesheet, the menus' among them, is held to its count of raw durations and curves in `UNTOKENED_MOTION` on the same terms."

8. Sanity check, then revert. Lower `"routes/lobby.css": 40` to `39` and see the surfaces test fail naming that sheet. Raise one entry and see it fail too. Restore both before stopping. This shows the test fails when a count moves, and is not a weakened check.

### `UNTOKENED_SURFACES` (60 sheets, 1153 in all)

I measured these by running the file's own `offSurface` and `offShadow` over every non-board sheet.

`audio/audio.css` 4, `auth/auth.css` 1, `auth/code-field.css` 23, `auth/consent.css` 3, `auth/tavern.css` 59, `auth/two-step.css` 1, `cards/art/art.css` 7, `cards/cards.css` 150, `cards/cardstate.css` 24, `cards/cosmetics.css` 38, `cards/dormant.css` 7, `cards/glitch.css` 9, `cards/inspect/inspect.css` 36, `cards/inspect/list-play.css` 2, `cards/keywords.css` 19, `cards/marks.css` 7, `cards/setmark.css` 6, `cards/stamps.css` 1, `cards/wheel/wheel.css` 6, `collection/collection.css` 27, `collection/cosmeticLook.css` 1, `collection/tokenOffer.css` 1, `duos/duos.css` 24, `economy/economy.css` 8, `economy/jlore-pill.css` 4, `economy/spend.css` 1, `emotes/emotes.css` 17, `emotes/portrait.css` 20, `empty/empty.css` 1, `fx/aura/aura.css` 3, `fx/fx.css` 106, `game/deckbuilder/deckbuilder.css` 66, `game/deckbuilder/workshop.css` 30, `game/table.css` 44, `notfound/notfound.css` 2, `packs/pack-object.css` 12, `packs/packs.css` 7, `patches/patches.css` 25, `practice/practice.css` 87, `practice/sandbox.css` 7, `rank/rankCrest.css` 1, `routes/account.css` 2, `routes/command-menu.css` 3, `routes/dev-panel.css` 5, `routes/entry-card.css` 3, `routes/game-banner.css` 21, `routes/landing.css` 61, `routes/lobby.css` 40, `routes/replays.css` 1, `routes/site-footer.css` 1, `routes/stats.css` 16, `routes/top-bar.css` 5, `settings/changeEmail.css` 2, `settings/settings.css` 25, `shop/shop.css` 2, `skeleton/skeleton.css` 4, `together/together.css` 16, `tutorial/path-visibility.css` 2, `tutorial/tutorial.css` 44, `undo/undo.css` 3.

### `UNTOKENED_MOTION` (36 sheets, 454 in all)

`auth/code-field.css` 13, `auth/tavern.css` 11, `cards/cards.css` 7, `cards/cosmetics.css` 40, `cards/dormant.css` 1, `cards/glitch.css` 6, `cards/inspect/inspect.css` 20, `cards/keywords.css` 27, `cards/marks.css` 7, `cards/wheel/wheel.css` 4, `collection/collection.css` 9, `duos/duos.css` 6, `economy/economy.css` 5, `economy/spend.css` 1, `economy/xp.css` 1, `emotes/emotes.css` 20, `emotes/portrait.css` 5, `fx/aura/aura.css` 2, `fx/fx.css` 61, `game/deckbuilder/deckbuilder.css` 16, `game/deckbuilder/workshop.css` 2, `game/table.css` 27, `packs/pack-object.css` 12, `packs/packs.css` 4, `practice/practice.css` 49, `rank/rankCrest.css` 2, `routes/game-banner.css` 6, `routes/landing.css` 25, `routes/lobby.css` 14, `routes/stats.css` 6, `routes/top-bar.css` 6, `settings/settings.css` 14, `shop/shop.css` 1, `skeleton/skeleton.css` 2, `tutorial/tutorial.css` 20, `undo/undo.css` 2.

No dungeon sheet appears, and neither do `surfaces.css`, `motion.css`, `palette.css`, `typescale.css` or `fonts.css`: their counts are 0.

The radius and layer counts match the issue's table (lobby 23 radii, practice 10 layers). Its motion column counts durations only. The totals here also count shadows, gradients and bare curves.

If the new test prints a different count for a sheet, trust its output over this table, because `main` may have moved since I measured. Paste the printed number only after checking that a CSS change on `main` explains it and not a mistake in your test.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/surfaces.test.ts`: new `#2109 no other stylesheet gains a radius, a shadow, a layer or a gradient of its own`. It counts each non-board sheet's `offSurface` + `offShadow` and asserts equality with `UNTOKENED_SURFACES`. It fails if a count rises or falls, if a new sheet has raw values, or if a listed key is a board sheet or no longer exists.
- `apps/web/src/motion.test.ts`: new `#2110 no other stylesheet gains a duration or a curve of its own`. It counts `offCurve` + `ownTimes` per non-board sheet and asserts equality with `UNTOKENED_MOTION`.
- The existing tests in both files stay as they are and must pass.

Commands, from the repo root:
```
sh scripts/build-wasm.sh
pnpm --dir apps/web test src/surfaces.test.ts
pnpm --dir apps/web test src/motion.test.ts
pnpm --dir apps/web test src/palette.test.ts src/typescale.test.ts
pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/surfaces.test.ts apps/web/src/motion.test.ts
```
Finally run `pnpm --dir apps/web test` (the full web suite, which the issue's acceptance names).

## Done when

- [ ] `surfaces.test.ts` and `motion.test.ts` cover every `.css` file under `apps/web/src`: board sheets at zero by the existing tests, every other sheet by the two new ones.
- [ ] Each non-board sheet with raw values is listed with its count. A rise, a fall or a new sheet fails the test (step 8 shown, then reverted).
- [ ] The README's surfaces and motion paragraphs say the menus are counted.
- [ ] No `.css`, component, spec or patch file changed. `git status` lists only the three files above.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, the web typecheck and eslint pass. The harness's checks (rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests) are green, with nothing in `crates/` changed.
- [ ] The decisions below are in the final report.

## Decisions to record

- **One number per sheet per test.** The kinds are summed (radius + shadow + layer + gradient; duration + curve), as `UNMIGRATED` and `UNSCALED` do. Rejected: a per-kind breakdown per sheet, which is about four times the table for a stricter hold, and can be a later issue.
- **Gradients are counted,** as the board's test counts them. Card faces, `game/table.css` and `fx/` stay listed with theirs. One comment above the list says why, with no per-entry reasons.
- **No "trivial exact match" migration.** `999px` to `--radius-pill` and `50%` to `--radius-round` (about 110 declarations) are left out. The issue allows them but does not require them. They would widen the diff to dozens of CSS files and risk a hand-error in each sheet's count. The other issues in this design pass lower the counts as they touch each sheet.

## Risks

- A CSS change that lands on `main` before this merges moves a sheet's count, and the exact-equality test then fails in the merge queue. The fix is the sheet's new number, or moving the new value onto a token. Re-run both tests after merging `main`.
- The tests skip any directory named `test`, as the existing ones do. Do not add a path filter that would drop a sheet.

## Open questions

None. The issue's scope is settled, and the judgment calls are in the decisions above.
````
